title: What If a Humpback Whale Swallowed You?

scenes.text: What if a humpback whale swallowed you? The twist is, it physically can't.
A humpback has no teeth. It has baleen plates that filter tiny fish and krill.
Its gulp can be huge, and its mouth can open around ten feet wide, so you could fit inside.
But the throat is roughly the size of a human fist, and it stretches to about 15 inches.
So you'd be engulfed, not swallowed, and the whale would push you back out.
Experts say swallowing a person is scientifically impossible. Only the sperm whale has a throat big enough.

description:
